## Description

Applies $L_1$-penalized Graphical Lasso to rolling asset return precision matrices to construct sparse conditional dependence networks, forecasting systemic risk and volatility spillovers.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash volatility contagion, multi-asset risk management, identifying systemic node assets.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Multi-Asset Risk Management Groups, Tail-Risk Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate asset return series across equities, commodities, sovereign debt, and foreign exchange.

## Caveats

Penalty parameter $lpha$ cross-validation is sensitive to structural breaks in underlying asset return distributions.
